integrity: Algebraic argument and exact F3 checks; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Literal reduction of the symmetric six-coordinate integral model only; not the characteristic-three reduction of other normal forms. Fifteen geometric nodes and reduced singular support proved; no singular-scheme decomposition or full K3 zeta polynomial asserted. Originality subject to inaccessible historical treatments.
title: The symmetric Burkhardt model in characteristic three is a cone over a 15-nodal K3 quartic
